payload.title: Pyleoclim figures with multiple panels
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to create multi-panel figures using the Pyleoclim library, which is built on top of Matplotlib. It focuses on combining individual plots into a larger figure for enhanced visualization. The notebook generates fractal noise data, creates time series, and demonstrates various methods for aligning these series in time. The outputs include stacked plots and plots using different interpolation methods.
goals: Combine individual plots into a larger figure using Pyleoclim.

section_blurbs.blurb: This section introduces the goal of combining individual plots into a larger figure using Pyleoclim. It includes code for generating fractal noise and creating time series data, which are then used to demonstrate various plotting techniques.
section_blurbs.heading: Pyleoclim figures with multiple panels

section_blurbs.blurb: This section highlights the importance of understanding Matplotlib for customizing Pyleoclim plots and discusses how Pyleoclim plots can be integrated into existing Matplotlib Axes objects for complex figure creation.
